newsitem.title: USA: CIA nominee investigated, senators not worried.
newsitem.headline: CIA nominee investigated, senators not worried.

text.p: Senate Intelligence Committee leaders said Wednesday that CIA director nominee George Tenet was under investigation for a family stock matter but they did not believe it was serious enough to jeopardise his nomination.
"It doesn't at this point, from what we know about it, look that serious," Sen. Richard Shelby, an Alabama Republican and chairman of the panel, told reporters.
"We believe we have a good nominee," Shelby said.
The committee's senior Democrat, Sen. Bob Kerrey of Nebraska, said: "It does not seem that serious to me (and) doesn't appear to endanger the nomination."
Shelby said the investigation was basically of some of Tenet's family stocks and possibly family property.
"Mr. Tenet's indicated to us he thinks it's basically worked out," Shelby said.
